source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. A stylish underground passage beneath an old city: a cool, sly urban-noir groove in a minor key, like sneaking through the coolest sewer in the world at night. Funky and jazzy, with a slinky slap bass line, tight dry drums with ghost notes, clavinet riffs and short muted brass stabs, a mysterious lead line on muted trumpet or vibraphone. Head-nodding and confident, tension without fear. Tempo 100 BPM, 4/4 time, key of D minor. Instrumentation: slap electric bass, tight funk drum kit with hi-hat ghost notes, clavinet, muted trumpet and saxophone section stabs, vibraphone, dark electric piano chords. Form: bass and drums groove intro, main riff with brass stabs, clavinet break, back to the riff. Duration: 80 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
